topics.title: Gold
paras: Gold is how the valley pays you, and how you put it back on its feet.
Earn it: put crops, fish and wild goods in the shipping bin. The bin pays the next morning.
Requests and jobs on the town board pay more than the bin.
Jars, kegs and the kitchen turn cheap goods into dear ones.
Spend it at Mara's. Each seed row says how many days it takes to ripen and what one harvest sells for.
Early on, parsnips pay back fastest. Dearer seeds earn more per tile.
Later: tool and can upgrades, a bigger bag, more land, animals, and the places you mend.

topics.title: The planting cycle
paras: Till with the hoe, plant a seed, then water it.
A crop grows one day each night its soil was watered. Dry soil: no growth that day.
Rain waters every crop. A sprinkler waters the ones around it every night.
The seed row at Mara's says the days to ripen. Corn and berries keep giving after the first harvest.
Every crop has its season. When the season turns, crops of the old one wither: harvest first.
A season is 28 days. In winter only kale and snow peas grow.
Fertilizer makes silver and gold crops more likely, and they sell for more.

topics.title: Jobs and requests
paras: Every morning villagers post three small jobs on the town board.
Tap Take: a job counts from then. Done? Turn it in at the board.
A finished job you never turn in is paid by post at night.
The board's requests want goods, and pay more than the bin.
A job done also wins the asker's friendship.

topics.title: Friends and hearts
paras: Talk to someone once a day: it counts toward their next heart. From two hearts, talk counts for less.
Gifts count more: one a day at most, and two a week per person. A birthday gift is always welcome.
What they love counts far more than what they barely notice. Silver and gold gifts count more.
The same present twice in two weeks is worth half.
At three hearts you learn their favourites. A letter warns you of a birthday the day before.
Every heart brings something: a letter, a discount, a recipe, a scene, even help on the farm. Their sheet says what the next one brings.

topics.title: Skills
paras: Four skills grow as you work: Farming, Foraging, Fishing and Mining.
Farming: harvesting and planting. Foraging: wild goods and bees. Fishing: what you catch. Mining: rocks and ore.
Dearer harvests and rarer fish teach more.
Each level brings a perk: better crops, more energy, double finds, a wider catch zone.
Levels also open recipes in Menu > Make: sprinklers and jars at Farming 2.
Menu > Skill shows each level, the XP to the next, and the perk it brings.

topics.title: Making things
paras: Menu > Make turns goods into things: bait, fertilizer, sprinklers, jars and buildings.
Most need fiber. Cut weeds with the scythe (1 each), pick up dry grass in the wild (2), or buy it at Mara's.
Stone comes from rocks in the mine, ore from its veins.
A locked row says what opens it: a skill level, or a friend who teaches it.
A row short of something says where to find it.

topics.title: Fishing and bait
paras: Face water with the rod and press Action. Wait for the bite, then reel it in.
Every cast takes one bait. Worms are free: the hoe and the scythe dig them up.
Bait Mix bites sooner. Fish Chum and Glow Grub bring rarer fish.
Each water has its own fish, by season and weather. Rain brings out the catfish.
Fish sell in the bin, fill requests on the board, and Finn loves a good one.

topics.title: The mine
paras: The mine is past the woods. Tap a rock: the pickaxe breaks it.
Rocks give stone. Veins give copper and iron ore.
New rocks appear every morning.
A furnace (Mining 2) smelts ore into bars. Bars upgrade your tools at the store.
Mining is hard work: bring something to eat.

topics.title: Sprinklers and jars
paras: Machines go on the farm: pick one on the hotbar, then Action places it.
A sprinkler waters the crops around it every night.
A preserve jar turns fruit into jam and vegetables into pickles, worth more than fresh.
Kegs, looms, bee houses and furnaces work the same way: load, wait, collect.
Tap a placed machine twice to pick it up and move it.

topics.title: Animals
paras: Make a coop in Menu > Make (Farming 3), place it, then buy chickens at Mara's.
Feed them every day. Eggs wait in the coop each morning.
A daily pat keeps them happy.
Barns, sheds and sties hold cows, sheep and pigs.

topics.title: Cooking
paras: A kitchen (the Home tab at Mara's) lets you cook in Menu > Make.
A dish gives energy back: three a day at full strength.
Some villagers love a dish more than anything.

topics.title: Mending the valley
paras: The valley's places broke when the river left. Each one belongs to someone.
When a place is asked for, Menu > Goal shows it under THE VALLEY.
Pay a little gold, bring its parts, and give a few days of work at the site.
Each mended place changes the map and opens a new way to play.
